systems.country_label: SIS-Sistema de Informação Sanitária para uma versão integrada

note: Republished Resolution 113/2021 approving the digital governance strategy 2021-2024 (approved 9 Dec 2021). Its annex lists structuring item EST-TEC10, the SIS 'for an integrated version', marked as existing, and EST-LEG13, the electronic prescription regulation, also existing; the SIS is not described, so it is unclassed and the strategy's naming of it cannot be taken as an HMIS or EMR plan fact.
